quests.dispatcherQuestion: Reactor coolant temperature rising abnormally in nuclear building 2. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the reactor coolant boost.
quests.explanation: Supplemental coolant injection keeps nuclear fuel below critical temperature thresholds during anomalous heat events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency diesel generator failing during a mandatory test cycle. Input code!
quests.hint: Restore backup power systems now.
quests.explanation: Nuclear plant emergency generators must restore power within 10 seconds to prevent instrumentation and cooling blackouts.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Containment building pressure gauge reading outside normal parameters. Input code!
quests.hint: Initiate an immediate containment check.
quests.explanation: Pressure anomalies in containment buildings require urgent inspection to rule out internal steam leaks or wall defects.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Dam water level exceeding spillway capacity after continuous heavy rainfall. Input code!
quests.hint: Open the spillway gates immediately.
quests.explanation: Opening spillway gates releases controlled water flow to prevent the dam wall from being overtopped and failing.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Structural crack detected in the dam face at the current water level. Input code!
quests.hint: Warn all downstream communities now.
quests.explanation: Downstream warnings give residents the critical lead time needed to evacuate before a potential dam failure wave.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency pumping needed to reduce the reservoir water level quickly. Input code!
quests.hint: Set outflow pump 3 to maximum capacity.
quests.explanation: Emergency pumping at maximum capacity reduces reservoir pressure and buys engineers time for structural repairs.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cargo vessel ran aground on a reef two miles offshore. Input tow code!
quests.hint: Deploy the tugboat immediately.
quests.explanation: Tugboats can free grounded vessels before hull stress fractures form, preventing total loss and environmental damage.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Grounded ship reporting hull breach in cargo hold 3. Input inspection code!
quests.hint: Dispatch coast guard to cargo hold 3.
quests.explanation: Coast guard marine engineers assess hull breach severity to determine whether patching or cargo transfer is the priority.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Fuel oil leaking from the damaged ship hull into surrounding waters. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate pollution control immediately.
quests.explanation: Rapid oil containment prevents coastal and reef contamination that can take decades to recover ecologically.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Six-vehicle pileup blocking all motorway lanes at junction 7. Input code!
quests.hint: Close the motorway at junction 7.
quests.explanation: Full motorway closure gives rescue and fire crews safe working space around a major multi-vehicle incident.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Trapped casualties in crushed vehicles requiring specialized cutting equipment. Input code!
quests.hint: Send heavy rescue to junction 7 now.
quests.explanation: Heavy rescue units carry hydraulic cutters and spreaders designed to open vehicle bodies for safe passenger extraction.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Fuel tanker involved in the crash is leaking diesel with explosion risk. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy the foam unit to the tanker.
quests.explanation: Foam blankets over diesel spills suppress vapors and reduce ignition risk near hot engine components.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Explosion in the solvent storage section of the chemical plant. Input code!
quests.hint: Lock down the chemical sector now.
quests.explanation: Sector lockdowns keep unauthorized personnel out and allow hazmat teams to work safely within the blast zone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Multiple workers have burns and chemical exposure injuries on site. Input code!
quests.hint: Declare a mass casualty incident at site A.
quests.explanation: MCI declarations release additional resources including specialist burn treatment teams and extra ambulances.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Secondary explosion risk from unstable material remaining in storage tank 6. Input code!
quests.hint: Evacuate within a 500-meter radius.
quests.explanation: A 500-meter evacuation zone provides a safety buffer from shrapnel and blast overpressure if a second explosion occurs.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Unauthorized person reported on school grounds near the main entrance. Input code!
quests.hint: Initiate school lockdown immediately.
quests.explanation: Lockdown procedures secure all classrooms and account for students while police respond to the intruder report.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Intruder confirmed on school property with police en route to the scene. Input code!
quests.hint: Keep all rooms locked and occupants in place.
quests.explanation: Room-in-place procedures keep students secured, reducing exposure and helping police contain the individual.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All students accounted for and intruder has been detained outside the school. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the all-clear for the school.
quests.explanation: A formal all-clear from law enforcement must precede any movement to ensure the threat is fully resolved.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Complete power failure affecting the entire hospital main building. Input code!
quests.hint: Start the emergency generator immediately.
quests.explanation: Hospital generators must restore power to surgical theatres and ICUs within 10 seconds to protect critical patients.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Generator running but the intensive care ward is not receiving power. Input code!
quests.hint: Switch the ICU to the backup distribution panel.
quests.explanation: ICU backup panel switching routes generator power directly to life-support equipment, bypassing failed boards.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Power restoration delayed over 60 minutes with blood bank refrigeration at risk. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy the portable cooling unit.
quests.explanation: Portable refrigeration units maintain blood products between 2 and 6 degrees Celsius until mains power is restored.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Pilot declaring emergency after single engine failure over the ocean. Input vectoring code!
quests.hint: Issue emergency vectoring to the nearest airport now.
quests.explanation: Emergency vectoring provides the most direct route to a suitable runway, maximizing fuel margins for a safe landing.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Passenger in cardiac arrest onboard the aircraft at cruising altitude. Input code!
quests.hint: Use the onboard automated defibrillator.
quests.explanation: Aviation defibrillators have voice-guided instructions that allow cabin crew without medical training to use them correctly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Fuel imbalance between wing tanks causing the aircraft to roll to one side. Input code!
quests.hint: Open the fuel crossfeed valve.
quests.explanation: Opening the crossfeed valve equalizes fuel load between wing tanks, restoring level flight and normal controllability.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Vehicle trapped inside a flooded underpass with driver still inside. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy the dive team to the underpass.
quests.explanation: Swift water dive teams are trained to locate and extract passengers from vehicles submerged in rapidly rising water.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Drainage system overwhelmed, flooding basement apartments in the block. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy pumps to the flooded basement block.
quests.explanation: High-capacity trailer-mounted pumps clear basement flooding before electrical systems are damaged by water contact.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Pedestrian swept into a storm drain by fast-moving floodwater. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Deploy swift water rescue to drain 4.
quests.explanation: Swift water rescuers use throw bags and rope systems to retrieve people swept into stormwater drainage channels.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Ammonia refrigerant leak detected in the industrial chiller room. Input code!
quests.hint: Evacuate the chiller room immediately.
quests.explanation: Ammonia is acutely toxic; even low concentrations cause severe respiratory damage, requiring immediate evacuation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Ammonia cloud forming outside the plant with wind direction toward the town. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue shelter advice for the north quarter.
quests.explanation: Sheltering in sealed upper-floor rooms keeps residents above ground-level ammonia concentration until the cloud disperses.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency repair team requires entry to the ammonia ruptured pipe zone. Input code!
quests.hint: Require full SCBA suits for all entry personnel.
quests.explanation: Self-contained breathing apparatus provides the only safe respiratory protection in ammonia-saturated atmospheres.
